sophia (docs): quick heads-up — I noticed the streaming + pagination examples in the SDK docs are inconsistent across py/ts/go. the python snippet still uses the old `stream=True` pattern and the go example drops the channel close in pagination. can we triage?
raj (eng): ack, can you point to the files?
sophia (docs): sources/docs/sdk/streaming.md and snippets under examples/streaming/* — i made a tiny failing link test in the docs build that flags it.
kai (sdk): thanks — i think the intended API surface changed to `client.stream(...)` in py/ts and `Stream()` wrapper in go. also retries/backoff example was missing in the paginated stream to show idempotent resume.
jen (release): is this a docs-only fix or do we need SDK patches too? if sdk code needs a minor helper, we want an opt-in change before release.
raj (eng): python and typescript are docs-only (examples). go needs a small fix — the iterator goroutine didn't close the resp channel on EOF which could leak for long runs. i'll open a tiny PR for that.
sophia (docs): i've opened PR #3428 with updated py/ts snippets and added a migration note. PTAL @kai @raj.
kai (sdk): looking. quick suggestion for the python snippet: prefer async generator example + explicit aclose in finally so readers don't copy a pattern that leaks sockets. propose this snippet in the doc: ```python
async for chunk in client.stream("/v1/generate", prompt=prompt):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
# ensure cleanup
await client.aclose()
```
raj (eng): for go i'll change the example to use context cancellation and close the chan in defer. small patch: ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
defer cancel()
streamCh := make(chan *Chunk)
go func() {
    defer close(streamCh)
    for {
        c, err := client.ReadChunk(ctx)
        if err != nil { return }
        streamCh <- c
    }
}()
for c := range streamCh { fmt.Print(c.Text) }
```
sophia (docs): perfect. also added a short note about retry/backoff for paginated streaming in the migration guide so folks know to resume from last-committed cursor.
jen (release): make sure the PR updates the mkdocs nav and that old links 404 -> new anchor (we have a redirect rule to add).
deploy-bot: docs site preview build succeeded for PR #3428 — https://deploy.preview/redwood/docs/pr-3428 :white_check_mark:
sophia (docs): thanks! i pushed a follow-up to include a short TS async example and clarified the pagination cursor key name (was `next_cursor` -> now `cursor`). please review when you have a sec. :pray:
kai (sdk): reviewed and left two inline comments about wording. overall LGTM. :thumbsup:
raj (eng): i'll ship the go fix as a micro release once tests pass.
sophia (docs): closing loop — i'll backport the snippets to the v2 docs folder after the go micro release is cut. thanks everyone!
